ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.5.1 is a profiler-overhead hotfix. The V0.4.5 WorkGiver detail profiler could add noticeable microstutter because hundreds of high-frequency WorkGiver phase methods were timed and aggregated on every call. V0.4.5.1 keeps the same diagnostic coverage but samples one in 32 job-package scopes during normal play, automatically bursts detailed capture after a 64ms+ job-package call, and removes the per-phase global lock/millisecond conversion from the hot path. V0.4.5 PathGrid invalidation deduplication, finalize-generation stale protection, the Butter++ manager-level logical-tick barrier, immutable path workers, and vanilla-authoritative gameplay remain unchanged.
